run_yuanbao_proto_tests: run the pytest test suite for yuanbao_proto varint encoding, conn codec, and biz layer round-trip tests
test_varint_encode_decode: test the varint encode and decode functions with small values, zero, 1-byte boundary, and multi-byte values
test_conn_codec_roundtrip: test the encode_conn_msg and decode_conn_msg functions for basic round-trip, empty data, and all command types
test_biz_codec_roundtrip: test the encode_biz_msg and decode_biz_msg functions for service, method, req_id, and response flag parsing
test_inbound_push_decode: test the decode_inbound_push function for parsing C2C text messages, group messages, and multiple msg body elements
